integrity: Includes a mathematical all-exponent proof and standalone finite independent profile-set tests; computations are not substituted for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic sum and weight-resolved spectrum at triadic lengths only. No nonsummed elementary formula for every exponent or arbitrary-length statement is established; initial level evaluations are illustrative. Originality is assessed against accessible published sources, with possible unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact weight-resolved \(2\)-binomial spectra of the Cantor word at triadic lengths
